org_slug_idx.name: org_slug_idx
org_slug_idx.where: "organization"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "organization"."deleted_at" IS NULL

brand_zernio_profile_owned_check.name: brand_zernio_profile_owned_check
brand_zernio_profile_owned_check.value: "brand"."zernio_profile_id" IS NULL OR "brand"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

audience_age_order_valid.name: audience_age_order_valid
audience_age_order_valid.value: "audience"."age_min" IS NULL OR "audience"."age_max" IS NULL OR "audience"."age_min" <= "audience"."age_max"

platform_ad_plan_ad_set_idx.name: platform_ad_plan_ad_set_idx
platform_ad_plan_ad_set_idx.where: "platform_ad"."ad_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_ad"."platform_delivery_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND lower(coalesce("platform_ad"."status", '')) NOT IN ('deleted', 'removed', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'archived')

performance_property_identified.name: performance_property_identified
performance_property_identified.value: "performance_property"."wander_url" is not null or "performance_property"."site_url" is not null or "performance_property"."title" is not null

home_group_owner_check.name: home_group_owner_check
home_group_owner_check.value: ("home_group"."brand_id" is not null and "home_group"."organization_id" is null) or ("home_group"."brand_id" is null and "home_group"."organization_id" is not null)

initiative_dates_check.name: initiative_dates_check
initiative_dates_check.value: "initiative"."end_at" IS NULL OR "initiative"."start_at" IS NULL OR "initiative"."end_at" >= "initiative"."start_at"

influencer_partnership_dates_check.name: influencer_partnership_dates_check
influencer_partnership_dates_check.value: ("influencer_partnership"."check_in" is null and "influencer_partnership"."check_out" is null) or ("influencer_partnership"."check_in" is not null and "influencer_partnership"."check_out" is not null and "influencer_partnership"."check_out" > "influencer_partnership"."check_in")
